title: GitHub lists free AI APIs for major models with no subscriptions or #OpenRouter #FreeAI #AItools
description: A GitHub repository lists every free AI API provider, giving access to top models like DeepSeek, Gemini, and Kimi at no cost. Users can quickly generate free API keys from providers such as OpenRouter, Grok, and NVIDIA NIM, then integrate them into tools like Claude Code or Cursor without subscriptions or payment. This opens new opportunities for developers, researchers, and hobbyists to experiment with AI technology without financial barriers. The availability of unrestricted testing accelerates innovation in AI agents, side projects, and early-stage product development. Access to free AI APIs challenges the market’s traditional paywall structure, promoting wider adoption and faster iteration cycles across industries focusing on AI-driven solutions. #FreeAIAPI #DeepSeek #GeminiAI #KimiAI #OpenRouter #GrokAI #NVIDIANIM #ClaudeCode #CursorAI #AIinnovation #AIAgents #AItools #MachineLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #APIintegration
